displayIdentity.body: The night advances and the reader is told to wake. Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed. But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.
